unsupported: The company remains a family-operated enterprise serving the Southwest from both storefronts.
The customer base spans automotive repair shops, engine builders, racing teams, fleet operators, and DIY enthusiasts throughout the El Paso and Tucson regions and beyond.
Industries served include automotive aftermarket, motorsports and performance, heavy-duty diesel, and general industrial engine maintenance.

The company was founded to provide local machine-shop expertise and quality engine parts, a mission that evolved into a broad parts-distribution model while retaining the original focus on engine-related products.
